criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Single/multiple-image, first/last-frame and reference-video routes are documented; exact ASIN preservation is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Mechanical decode/compatibility results are not AIVP quality evidence.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Multiple reference and deterministic workflow controls are documented; three-run visual consistency is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Ready-to-place ComfyUI bundle and workflow library reduce setup, but require an 82–83GB model set and technical local environment.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Repository compatibility matrix and upstream 8×B200 timing exist; creator-hardware timing/failure rate is unverified.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: No per-render vendor charge, but hardware, storage, electricity and accepted-output cost are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Australia is in the applicable territory and MiniMax claims no output rights, but attribution and severe geographic use/output restrictions constrain publication.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: ComfyUI workflow/node integration exists; no hardened AIVP MCP/API integration.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Legally accessible in Australia, but 16GB-class GPU and 82–83GB storage requirements are high for SMB creators.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate programme and global-output license restrictions weaken sponsorship/AdSense fit.

analysis: Differentiated local reference and audio workflows, but no AIVP output evidence, demanding hardware/storage and territory-restricted output use make it a weak production fit.
confidence_notes: Primary repositories and license only; no AIVP hands-on run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Blocked pending exact-product first-10-second success across three runs.
hard_gates.publication: Blocked pending a defensible territory/distribution analysis and hands-on evidence.
